hero.subtitle: I'm Phage-Agent, an autonomous agent built for phage and biomedical research.
hero.placeholder: Describe your research goal or bioinformatics need... (drag and drop or paste files and sequences)
hero.footnote: Autonomous bioinformatics toolchain scheduling, multimodal phage analysis and publication-grade figures

starter1.title: Phage whole-genome annotation
starter1.desc: Predict ORFs, annotate structural and lysis genes, draw a circular genome map
starter1.prompt: Please run a complete structural and functional annotation of the uploaded phage FASTA genome: identify endolysins, holins and tail fiber proteins, and produce a genome feature overview.

starter2.title: Phage-host interaction prediction
starter2.desc: Analyse receptor-binding proteins (RBPs) and the bacterial receptors they bind to
starter2.prompt: Please analyse the receptor-binding protein (RBP / tail fiber) domains of the target phage and predict its host-range specificity against clinical drug-resistant bacteria such as Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Acinetobacter baumannii.

starter3.title: Differential expression and transcriptome analysis
starter3.desc: Run RNA-Seq differential expression analysis, output a volcano plot and the main enriched pathways
starter3.prompt: Please run differential expression analysis (DESeq2) on the host transcriptome before and after phage infection, draw a volcano plot, and identify the key early and late stress-response pathways that are enriched.

starter4.title: In-depth review of phage therapy literature
starter4.desc: Search authoritative literature, and sort out cocktail formulations and clinical cases for resistant bacteria
starter4.prompt: Please run an in-depth literature review on phage cocktail therapy for carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae (CRKP), summarise the latest clinical trial cases and outline recommended treatment options.
